title: inHabit
team: Andrea Cutroni, Elena Corio, Symon Kipkemei, Marina Osmolovska, Giovanni Carlo Volpe
description: An AI spatial-intelligence copilot that turns a description of daily routines into the housing layout that actually fits them.
body: inHabit bridges architectural layouts and daily routines under the brief "Describe your day. Find your layout." Natural-language text is converted into structured spatial criteria to help households, architects and real-estate agents evaluate housing options.

Built on LangGraph, Anthropic's API and a NetworkX spatial graph, the tool extracts user preferences, runs graph-based semantic search across 800+ synthetic floor plans, and overlays the user's daily routine onto candidate layouts alongside a daylight analysis — scoring fit, simulating daylight and visualizing the routine before a final layout is selected.
